overall: The AG found no Open Meeting Law violation: the Chair may decide who speaks, and incivility allegations are outside the law, so the AG declined to review the insulting-remarks claim.

allegations.summary: Complaint alleged the Chair did not allow an attendee to ask a question during the September 16, 2019 meeting.
allegations.key_passage: The law permits the Chair of the Commission to decide who can speak at a meeting.

allegations.summary: Complaint alleged the Chair made insulting remarks toward the complainant during the September 16, 2019 meeting.
allegations.key_passage: An allegation of unprofessional conduct or incivility towards a member of the Commission or the public does not constitute a violation of the Open Meeting Law.
